name: Haus Alpenblick
beschreibung:
Gently elevated above the valley floor in Soelden, Haus Alpenblick welcomes visitors with warm family hospitality and tidy guestrooms. Panoramic views of glacier-capped peaks inspire guests every morning.

Mountain cable cars, cross-country tracks, and Soelden village center are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpenblick in Soelden offers cosy accommodation and panoramic views of the Oetztal peaks.
